semiconductor_relevance: High — Fabmatics specializes in automation solutions for material handling in semiconductor factories, enhancing efficiency and safety.
summary: Fabmatics GmbH provides advanced material handling automation solutions tailored for cleanroom environments in the semiconductor industry. With over 30 years of experience, the company integrates robotics, RFID, and software to optimize intralogistics, handling, and storage processes.
capabilities: Automated reticle handling and storage systems
Mobile robots for cleanroom transport of reticle pods
High-density automated storage and retrieval systems
Load ports and mask handling equipment

regional_presence.Germany: Headquartered in Dresden, Germany, Fabmatics has a strong market position in the automation of semiconductor factories.
